SALTAY LIFE

What imprint are you leaving behind?


Saltay is an aquatic, peaceful feeling. Saltay comes when you bask in the life-giving seas, roll in the sand, laugh, spend precious moments with family and friends, and simply thrive on being authentically Saltay.

Spirit is a way of being true, beyond one’s self and others. It relates to our connection to Source, ancestors, elements and individual Faith.

Saltay Life, inspired by Aloha, is “the coordination of mind and heart within each person and the essence of relationships in which each person is important to every other person for collective existence.”

To embody the Saltay life, one must consider what footprint they are leaving behind and remember that our energetic imprint is left on everything we breath, eat and touch.  Saltay comes from the inside, out.

At Saltay, Hanalei Bay, we encourage everyone to In•body freedom, In•body Aloha, and In•Body IT ~ the Saltay Spirit.
